extracted text: The paper analyzes the AlSi9Cu3(Fe) alloy (EN AB-46000, equivalent to the US designation A380). The die-castings were stored at room temperature for about 5 months before being analyzed and were similar to a T1 condition. The tensile specimens were tested with different gage diameters (6.0 mm, 3.4 mm, and 3.0 mm), producing different mechanical properties. Vickers microhardness ranges between 95 and 125 HV, with a mean value of about 110 HV.
